title: feat(011why11): t(5,0,0)=9 under (0,1,1) via cheap seed-exit then return cost 3
science: (0,1,1) counterpart to #6779: t(5,0,0)=9 on B_16(0) via the y=-1 corridor (six cost-1 hops then one cost-3 support drop) against the on-axis sum 1+3+3+3+3=13, so the corridor mechanism is the same under the cheaper rule. Methodological improvement over #6779: builds the shortest-path DAG explicitly (predecessor map + backward reachability) and walks the lex-least successor, rather than carrying paths on the heap.
